content.title: Chapter 78 - PUBLIC IMPROVEMENTS — Sec. 78-52. - Lowest and best bid accepted.
content.summary:
The city may contract only with the responsible bidder submitting the lowest and best
               bid upon proper terms.
(Code 1981, § 27-53; Ord. No. 551, § 19(D), 5-14-1964)
State Law reference—
Similar provisions, C.R.S. § 31-25-516.
